<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1974477_skillnow.SkillNowFilters</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>SkillNowFilters</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var SkillNowFilters = Class.create();
SkillNowFilters.prototype = Object.extendsObject(global.AbstractAjaxProcessor, {

    getAvailableSchedules: function() {
        var user = gs.getUserID();
        var enrolledSchedules = [];

        
        var gr = new GlideRecord('x_1974477_skillnow_enrollment');
        gr.addQuery('opened_by', user);
        gr.query();

        while (gr.next()) {
            enrolledSchedules.push(gr.getValue('schedule'));
        }

		var filter = 'training_date>=javascript:gs.daysAgoStart(0)';

		if (enrolledSchedules.length > 0) {
			filter += '^sys_idNOT IN' + enrolledSchedules.join(',');
		}

		return filter;
    },

    type: 'SkillNowFilters'
});]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-05-12 14:37:21</sys_created_on><sys_id>9efbedb593f483101b12f987dd03d6dc</sys_id><sys_mod_count>2</sys_mod_count><sys_name>SkillNowFilters</sys_name><sys_package display_value="SkillNow" source="x_1974477_skillnow">6e1ce8a9937003101b12f987dd03d608</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="SkillNow">6e1ce8a9937003101b12f987dd03d608</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_9efbedb593f483101b12f987dd03d6dc</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-05-12 15:25:56</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
